topic: CoffeeMan published ground-coffee quantity promotion (10% off from a ₪250 item subtotal, multipacks excluded)
method: Bounded HTTP GET with a descriptive research user agent through the coding runner (no browser session, no login, no account, no order, no cart/session/cookie values recorded). The three tracked CoffeeMan product pages were read to compare their promotion banners; the banner HTML is the same markup the adapter parses deterministically (promotionName/promotionDesc).

pages.listing: Crema e Gusto Classico 250 g single pack (SKU 930333)
pages.bannerDescription: קונים  קפה טחון מכל המותגים המובילים  ב-250 ש"ח ומקבלים 10% הנחה אוטומטית בקופה על הקפה שבחרתם. (לא כולל מארזים ובאנדלים)
pages.translation: All ground coffee at 10% off. Buy ground coffee from all leading brands for ₪250 and get an automatic 10% discount at checkout on the coffee you chose. (Not including multipacks and bundles.)

pages.listing: Crema e Gusto Classico 4 × 250 g multipack (SKU 930334)
pages.bannerName: מיכל ואקום שקוף חשמלי לאיחסון קפה
pages.bannerDescription: בכל קנייה באתר של קפה, קפסולות ואביזרים מעל 990 ש"ח  קבל מיכל ואקום שקוף חשמלי לאיחסון קפה בשווי של 299 ש"ח , מתנה  !
pages.note: A gift banner, not a percent-off rule: the parser ignores it, and the multipack is excluded from the ground-coffee promotion by the vendor wording anyway.

pages.listing: Crema e Gusto Classico 8 × 250 g multipack (SKU 930335)
pages.bannerName: מיכל ואקום שקוף חשמלי לאיחסון קפה
pages.bannerDescription: בכל קנייה באתר של קפה, קפסולות ואביזרים מעל 990 ש"ח  קבל מיכל ואקום שקוף חשמלי לאיחסון קפה בשווי של 299 ש"ח , מתנה  !
pages.note: Same gift banner as the 4-pack page; no ground-coffee percent-off rule is advertised for the multipacks.

crossCheck.observedCart: 8 × 250 g single packs = ₪264 item subtotal, ₪237.60 total after the automatic 10% checkout discount (within the 2026-10-12 19:56-20:09 UTC research window)
crossCheck.boundary: The vendor wording is 'ב-250 ש"ח' (at ₪250), so the board applies an at-least boundary; the exact ₪250 cart was not observed, and the nearest observations (₪231 no discount, ₪264 discounted) are consistent with the published wording.

scope.appliesTo: Lavazza Crema e Gusto single 250 g packs only; the multipacks are excluded by the vendor's own wording and pages
scope.boardEffect: The item subtotal of the 8 × 250 g single-pack offer at a 2 kg target is ₪237.60 instead of ₪264.00; the published ₪25 courier rate still applies (no shipping discount is inferred), so the delivered total is ₪262.60 and the 8-pack remains the cheapest CoffeeMan offer at ₪260.00.
scope.noInvention: The base unit price (₪33), stock observation time and refresh marker are never changed by applying the promotion; the raw vendor wording and retrieval time stay in the offer details.
